newsitem.title: PORTUGAL: PORTUGUESE SHARES BOUNCE OFF LOWS, EYE WALL ST.
newsitem.headline: PORTUGUESE SHARES BOUNCE OFF LOWS, EYE WALL ST.

text.p: 1610 GMT - Shares closed above session lows but failed to shake off the negative mood completely.
*However, some traders feel that despite the uncertainties abroad, particularly over the direction of U.S. interest rates, the domestic market could resume its advance soon.
*"Our situation is not the same as theirs (foreign markets). We are still expecting (local) rates to fall," said one trader.
*Traders could point to no special situations. Mundial Confianca was one stock to move against the softer trend although traders said there was no particular factors.
*Cimpor and Banco Comercial Portugues were amongst the biggest losers as the index slipped 0.76 percent to 8,217.03.
